title: GROMACS：PME 分工與科學精度下的負載平衡
titleEn: GROMACS: PME partitioning under a scientific accuracy contract
subcategoryTitle: 分子、電子結構與粒子科學計算
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「GROMACS：PME 分工與科學精度下的負載平衡」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付七種分工帳本、雙支線時間圖、精度比對及不可行分工的排除理由。
summaryEn: Investigate GROMACS: PME partitioning under a scientific accuracy contract using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a seven-partition ledger, branch timelines, numerical accuracy comparisons and explicit rejection reasons for unsupported decompositions, with all timing values labeled as synthetic.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

optionsEn: Long PME waiting can reflect expensive mesh work, late PP input or serialized exchange. A single averaged CPU utilization percentage cannot discriminate these competing explanations.
Treat the modeled optimum as a candidate. Select a production allocation only when supported decomposition, repeated timing and the unchanged scientific accuracy contract all pass independent review.

knowledge.text: 同時執行的 PP 與 PME 取較長者，再加不可重疊交換。理想分工模型不保證軟體能採用任意整數分配。
knowledge.textEn: Concurrent PP and PME branches contribute their maximum duration, followed by serialized exchange. Ideal division by rank count assumes perfect scaling within each branch and does not establish that every integer partition is supported.

stages.title: 建立兩條依賴路徑
stages.description: 畫 PP、PME 與交換的資料箭頭；在交換前標記兩支線都須完成，並列出本模型省略的 FFT 通訊。
stages.descriptionEn: Draw PP, PME and exchange dependencies. Mark the join where both branches must finish, and list FFT communication, topology effects and load imbalance that the constant-work model does not resolve.
